pages.text: With this focus, you can continuously summon a wrathful wraith brimming with overflowing resentment that charges at your target and detonates on impact. Its fury changes form depending on the staff you wield and the world you are in.

When wielding a $(l:crafts/staff/wild_staff)Wild Staff$() or in a swamp, the wraith's body becomes filled with acid; when wielding a $(l:crafts/staff/void_staff)Void Staff$() or in the End, Magic Fire burn in place of its Ice Fire; the $(l:crafts/staff/nameless_staff)Nameless Staff$() upgrades the wraith's Ice Fire to Death Fire; and when wearing Unholy Set while casting in the Nether or with a $(l:crafts/staff/nether_staff)Nether Staff$(), the wraith becomes closer to a Damned in essence.
